The Chinese characters for Timothy

As a transliteration, Timothy is usually written 蒂莫西 (Dì mò xī). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

Origin and meaning

The name Timothy has Greek roots and means “honouring God”.

About the name Timothy

In the New Testament, Timothy was a young companion of Saint Paul.

As a gift or a tattoo

People often order Timothy as a framed gift or as a tattoo — the meaning, “honouring God”, is part of the appeal.
